Port Guichon is the west Ladner pocket around Port Guichon Elementary and West River Road, in the City of Delta.
The school inside the pocket is Port Guichon Elementary (Kindergarten to Grade 7) at 4381 46a Street.
Ladner is one of Delta's South Delta communities, and Port Guichon is governed by the Delta Official Community Plan (OCP) 2024, Bylaw No. 8400, adopted July 8, 2024, a single consolidated plan.
The pocket is low-density and ground-oriented, with detached houses, half duplexes and river-side homes.
Delta's Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (SSMUH) framework already shows here as coach houses above rear-lane garages on Savoy Street homes.

faq.a: Port Guichon Elementary is inside the pocket, at 4381 46a Street for Kindergarten to Grade 7. The British Columbia (BC) Ministry of Education list for School District 37 (Delta) gives that name and address. Whether a specific home address falls in its catchment must still be checked by address, because district catchments are address-based.
faq.q: Which elementary school is inside Port Guichon?

faq.a: Check the exact address in the district School Locator before relying on a school. School District 37 directs families to the Baragar Online School Locator by residential address or postal code. The district also publishes Ladner Area catchment boundary maps, updated October 2017.
faq.q: How do I confirm my catchment?

faq.a: A coach house or suite may be possible, subject to a parcel-level City check. The City also runs help for owners creating coach houses, garden suites and secondary suites. River-side lots need extra checks for streamside and flood rules.
faq.q: Can I add a coach house or suite?

faq.a: Residents reach the Canada Line by TransLink route 601 to Bridgeport Station. The route runs via South Delta Exchange, Highway 17, Ladner Exchange, Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99. Check the current timetable for the stop nearest a specific address.
faq.q: How do residents reach the Canada Line?

faq.a: Port Guichon Elementary (K–7), at 4381 46a St, Delta, on the BC Ministry of Education's SD37 school list. Whether a specific Port Guichon address is in its catchment must be checked in the SD37 locator — catchments are address-based.
faq.q: Which elementary school is in Port Guichon?

faq.a: Delta's SSMUH zoning updates allow up to four units on all single-detached and duplex lots, and the City supports accessory dwelling units such as coach houses, garden suites and secondary suites. What applies to a specific lot is a City parcel check.
faq.q: Can a Port Guichon lot add a suite or coach house?

faq.a: By TransLink route 601, which runs from South Delta via South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station, via Highway 17, Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99.
